sql: SELECT 'O' k, market_ticker t, side||'/'||action||'/'||status s, limit_price::text p, quantity::text q, coalesce(cancel_reason,'') r, created_at::text at FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Alimm1' AND market_ticker LIKE 'KXYTVIEWSHIGH-TAY26DEC%' AND created_at > now()-interval '2 days' UNION ALL SELECT 'F', f.market_ticker, f.side||'/'||f.action, f.price::text, f.quantity::text, f.fee::text, f.filled_at::text FROM fills f JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id WHERE o.strategy='Alimm1' AND f.filled_at > now()-interval '4 hours' ORDER BY 1,7
